name: @doodle-lang/lezer-doodle
description: A Lezer grammar for the Doodle language: editor syntax highlighting and the §6.4 grammar-parity gate (the grammar and the engine parser must classify a shared corpus identically).

scripts.build:grammar: mkdir -p dist && lezer-generator src/doodle.grammar -o dist/parser.js && cp src/tokens.js dist/tokens.js && cp src/parser.d.ts dist/parser.d.ts
